theory: The kite diagram incorrectly labels the upper vertical segment as half of the full diagonal: a kite's symmetry diagonal is not generally bisected, and the drawn upper and lower segments are unequal. Distinguish kite diagonal segments from rhombus half-diagonals and state that only the other diagonal is bisected in a general kite; the area formula uses full diagonals.
